恭喜恭喜2017(Gongxi Gongxi)
snippet.description:
巴塔木祝大家鸡年吉祥，万事如意！
鸡年生鸡(机)勃勃！
恭喜发财！新年快乐！

snippet.title: 洗漱颂(Brush Brush Brush)
snippet.description:
It’s time to brush, Badanamu boys and girls! 
Bada and all his buddies are getting squeaky clean, and you can too.
Learn how to brush your teeth, wash your face, and brush your hair—Badanamu style!

snippet.title: 动物园派对(Zoo Party)
snippet.description:
动物园派对开始了~
所有的动物朋友都来了！
学习一下动物们的声音吧~
It’s time for the Zoo Party and all our animal friends are coming! 
Learn how to make animal sounds like cat, dog, horse, and many more. 

Check out the free animal masks in the Badanamu Club.
http://www.badanamu.com/portfolio/zoo... ‎

snippet.description:
这些有趣的恐龙朋友们乘坐恐龙巴士回来了！
让我们一起跟着唱起来！
Our playful dinosaur friends are back with the Dino Bus! 
Can you watch and sing along with them? 

Not sure about the words? 
Don’t worry! Here’s a sing along printable to help:
http://bit.ly/badaBus_Singalong

snippet.description:
跟着巴塔进行宇宙探险吧！
巴塔很会跳舞哦！
Come with Bada to Umpa moon! Learn how to dance the Umpa Mumpa way.

snippet.description:

看看它们是怎么吃的吧~
Cute, fluffy, little kittens in mittens and they all want pie!
Let’s all sing along with Jess and her darling kittens in the classic nursery rhyme, “Three Little Kittens.”

snippet.description:
小猪米皮又跟大家见面了！
它可以跳舞、可以涂鸦。甚至可以滑滑板！
Mipi the pig is back! 
He can dance. He can paint. He can even ride a skate board! 
Mipi is an amazing little piggy. Let’s sing along as Mipi makes his way around Badanamu in the classic nursery rhyme, “This Little Piggy.”

snippet.description:
Quack, quack, quack! 
像大家介绍巴塔的新朋友们！可爱的小鸭子！
Bada has some new friends to introduce. 
They’re cute, fuzzy, little ducklings! Watch them wibble-wobble to and fro in the classic nursery rhyme “Six Little Ducks.”

snippet.title: 翻滚歌(Six in the Bed)
snippet.description:
巴塔木的世界里，在床上睡觉的时间也是有趣的时间！
当小艾比说‘翻滚’的时候，所有的小伙伴都会做出翻滚的动作。
让我们从6开始倒数到1吧~
Even bedtime is a fun game in Badanamu! 
All the friends are snuggled in bed when our little friend, Abby, starts telling everyone to "roll over." 
Can you count down from 6 to 1 with us?

Join in and sing along:
http://bit.ly/1S3A1TQ
Join the Badanamu Club for fun number printables:
http://bit.ly/badaclub

snippet.title: 下雨天(Rain Rain Go Away)
snippet.description:
巴塔和朋友们在森林里玩耍。
但是下雨了~ 小伙伴们都躲到树叶下面了。
只有这些可爱的艾克(Ecco)们在愉快的玩耍！
他们热爱大自然，即使在下雨。
What a rainy, rainy day! 
All the friends are out to play in the forest when the rain comes pouring down. 
Quick! Everyone hides under a leaf, including Fat Cat Mat! Squish! 
Bada and friends may be hiding, but not our NEW friends, the Eccos. 
They are playful forest creatures who love nature, even the rain!




Would you like to sing along with us? You can find the lyrics sheet here:
http://bit.ly/BadaRain_Singalong

snippet.description:

snippet.title: 号角男孩(Little Boy Blue)
snippet.description:
克里有的新的工作。
他需要照顾可爱的母牛和小绵羊！
但是... 克里哪里去了呢？或许是在偷懒睡觉。
Curly has an important new job. 
He must look after the cute, fuzzy cows and sheep. 
But...Where is Curly? Where has he gone? 
Uh-oh! I think he fell asleep with Fat Cat Mat and the cutie kittens. 
Let's watch and see!

Want to sing along? You can download the sing-along printable here:

snippet.title: 农场歌(Jess and Curly Had a Farm)
snippet.description:
欢迎来到杰西和克里的农场！
Jess and Curly are chilling out on their farm. 
Jess is hopping around on her awesome hopping horses. 
Curly is cruising on his cool skateboard. E-I-E-I-O! 

Learn animal names and sounds: OWL, PIG, COW, CAT, and SHEEP.

Sing along with us:
http://bit.ly/BadaSing_JessCurlyFarm

Join the Badanamu Club for free printables and more:
http://bit.ly/badaclub

snippet.title: 幸福拍手歌(If You are Happy)
snippet.description:
今天心情怎么样？
高兴？生气？来电幸福的感觉怎么样？
跟着巴塔和朋友们一起唱这首‘幸福拍手歌’吧~
How are you feeling today? 
Happy? Grumpy? How about pretty? 
What a great way to learn some new adjectives and emotions! 
Let’s sing along with Bada and all his magical friends in their new nursery rhyme, "If You're Happy and You Know It!"

Sing along with us:
http://www.badanamu.com/wp-content/up...
Join the Badanamu Club for free song activities and printables:
http://eepurl.com/VGlwP

snippet.title: 跳跃歌(Hop Pop Stop)
snippet.description:
一起来学习短音O的声音吧！
Are you ready to sing some O sounds?

Listen for the short O sounds like hop, pop, and stop. 
Can you hear the long O sounds too? Listen for words, like go and low.

Join Bada and the Badanamu band for a whole lot of fun! 
Check out Abby singing, Mipi playing the bass drum, Mimi on keyboards, and Mat on snare. 
Most of all check out Punk break dancing!

This is a wonderful fun way to learn all your O sounds.

snippet.title: 滴答滴答钟声响(Hickory Dickory Dock)
snippet.description:
滴答滴答！
巴塔和朋友们在跟大钟玩耍！
攀上和滑下的方式都各不相同。
看！克里的滑板好酷！
Tick tock! Tick tock! 
Bada and friends are playing with a clock. 
Everyone has a fun way to run up and down. 
Check out Curly with his cool skateboard! 
Who’s is your favorite? 
Let us know in the comments below. 

Do you want to sing along? 
You can download a sing-along sheet here:
http://bit.ly/BadaHickory_Singalong

snippet.description:
巴塔木祝你生日快乐！
Happy, happy birthday from Badanamu!

snippet.description:
巴塔木的夏天到了！
有谁想一起出去戏水的吗？
巴塔和朋友们正在试图将肥猫马特淋湿！
It’s summer time in Badanamu! 
Who wants to go outside and play with water? 
Bada and all the friends are all set to get the pet wet! 

Let’s try to sing and dance along with the song. Can you hear the pattern? “Get the Pet Wet” is full of short E sounds. You can download the sing-along sheet here:
http://www.badanamu.com/wp-content/up...

Don’t forget to sign up for the Badanamu Club for more free activities.

snippet.description:
跟着朋克、克里、杰西一起跳企鹅舞吧！

snippet.description:
巴塔和朋友们在森林里玩耍。

只有这些可爱的艾克(Ecco)们在愉快的玩耍！

Bada and friends may be hiding, but not our NEW friends, the Eccos. 
They are playful forest creatures who love nature, even the rain!

跟着巴塔和朋友们一起唱这首‘幸福拍手歌’吧~
How are you feeling today? 
Happy? Grumpy? How about pretty? 
What a great way to learn some new adjectives and emotions! 
Let’s sing along with Bada and all his magical friends in their new nursery rhyme, "If You're Happy and You Know It!"

snippet.title: 跳跃歌(Hop Pop Stop)
snippet.description:
一起来学习短音O的声音吧！
Are you ready to sing some O sounds?

Listen for the short O sounds like hop, pop, and stop. 
Can you hear the long O sounds too? Listen for words, like go and low.

Join Bada and the Badanamu band for a whole lot of fun! 
Check out Abby singing, Mipi playing the bass drum, Mimi on keyboards, and Mat on snare. 
Most of all check out Punk break dancing!

This is a wonderful fun way to learn all your O sounds.
